Tinted Icons listing copy vs engineering vs screenshot design

Icon-tinting apps blur three workstreams indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers layer 1 only.

  • App Store Connect listing metadata — name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshot overlay captions on the zh-Hans row. AppLocale scope.
  • Icon tint / theme UI in the app — wallpaper-aware recoloring, theme engines, Customize Home Screen companion flows, preview renderers. Engineering scope — not AppLocale.
  • Screenshot composition — device frames, tinted-icon before/after mockups, color swatch grids, re-exporting PNGs with burned-in tint headlines. Design scope — AppLocale delivers caption lines you paste or hand to a designer.

This page covers the first bucket for Tinted Icons-centric product pages. It is not our Home Screen widgets guide (WidgetKit gallery), not our Alternate app icons guide (per-app icon picker), and not our Home Screen layout guide (jiggle mode and icon rearrangement without tinting as lead).

Home Screen widgets (different guide — LIVE)

WidgetKit gallery on the Home Screen — Add Widget picker, small/medium/large layouts, widget stacks beside app icons. Home Screen widget marketing is covered by the Home Screen widgets listing guide, not icon tinting copy.

Lock Screen widgets (different guide — LIVE)

Portrait Lock Screen accessory slots — circular, rectangular, and inline widgets above or below the clock. Lock Screen accessory marketing is covered by the Lock Screen widgets listing guide, not Home Screen icon tinting.

Interactive widgets (different guide — LIVE)

iOS 17+ tap, toggle, and complete-from-widget controls on the Home Screen without opening the app. Interactive-widget marketing as the lead story is covered by the Interactive widgets listing guide — not Tinted Icons color swatches alone.

Apple Watch Smart Stack (different guide — LIVE)

Rotating widget stack on the Apple Watch face — turn the Digital Crown to cycle glanceable widgets on the wrist. Watch Smart Stack (智能叠放) is covered by the Smart Stack listing guide — not iPhone Home Screen icon tinting.

StandBy mode (different guide — LIVE)

Landscape charging nightstand view — clock, photos, and widget carousels when iPhone charges in landscape. StandBy nightstand marketing is covered by the StandBy listing guide, not Tinted Icons picker flows as the primary angle.

Control Center (different guide — LIVE)

Swipe-down toggles and controls — brightness, connectivity, and custom Control Center buttons. Control Center marketing is covered by the Control Center listing guide — not Home Screen icon tint swatches.

Focus modes & Focus Filters (different guides — LIVE)

Do Not Disturb, Work Focus, and per-app Focus Filters — notification profiles and home-screen app filtering when a Focus is active. Focus marketing is covered by the Focus modes listing guide and Focus Filters listing guide — not system icon tinting.

Alternate app icons (different guide)

Per-app seasonal or themed icon pickers — Choose Icon sheets, CFBundleAlternateIcons, dark-mode icon variants inside one app. Alternate icon marketing is covered by the Alternate app icons listing guide — not system-wide Tinted Icons that recolor every icon on the grid.

Common mistakes on Tinted Icons zh-Hans listings

  • Leaving “Tinted Icons” untranslated everywhere — mixing English product vocabulary with otherwise Chinese copy looks unfinished on the China storefront
  • Calling Tinted Icons “widgets” — buyers searching for 小组件 expect WidgetKit gallery marketing; icon tinting deserves 着色图标 or 图标着色 phrasing
  • Using Focus or Control Center vocabulary on tint frames — 专注模式 and 控制中心 belong on Focus and Control Center guides, not icon tint swatch copy
  • Confusing Tinted Icons with alternate app icons — system-wide tint recolors every icon; per-app Choose Icon pickers are a different buyer story
  • Machine-translated “Customize Home Screen” — awkward literal translations instead of concise 自定义主屏幕-style phrasing buyers recognize
  • Translating only the description — name, subtitle, and keywords still English while Tinted Icons screenshots dominate the gallery
  • English burned into PNG exports — Connect caption fields are zh-Hans but overlay text on the image file is still Latin script
  • Assuming theme-engineering work localizes the store page — engineering and App Store metadata are independent workstreams

  • ChatGPT 翻译腔 on tint jargon — literal translations of “icon tint shader” or “tinted appearance” that native readers do not use in App Store copy

What good zh-Hans Tinted Icons listing copy looks like

Listing fields should name the icon-tinting surfaces you actually ship — aligned with gallery order:

  • Subtitle — one concrete promise: “主屏幕着色图标，一键统一色调” or “图标着色，浅色/深色/着色模式” — not vague “美化桌面”

  • Swatch labels in caption lines — when your gallery shows color picker names, caption sheet lists zh-Hans equivalents for designer re-export
  • Voice consistency — same 你/您 choice as your description across overlay lines and promotional text

Connect checklist for Tinted Icons apps targeting China

  1. Open App Store → Chinese (Simplified) — confirm the zh-Hans row exists; empty rows fall back to English on the China storefront
  2. Audit searchable fields — name, subtitle, keywords, description saved in zh-Hans, not placeholder English
  3. Walk the screenshot gallery in order — flag frames showing Tinted Icons picker, light/dark/tinted mode toggles, color swatch grids, before/after icon tint comparisons, or English overlay copy
  4. Export overlay lines — spreadsheet of English caption text per frame beats screenshots of Connect alone
  5. Note burned-in vs Connect captions — if swatch labels are embedded in PNGs, caption deliverables go to your designer for re-export
  6. Match What's New if Tinted Icons support is new — release notes should mention icon tinting in zh-Hans when that version added tint workflows
  7. Verify China in Pricing and Availability — storefront enabled before expecting zh-Hans to appear
  8. Separate engineering tasks — theme engines, tint preview renderers, and in-app customization UI stay with your dev team

FAQ

Does AppLocale implement Home Screen icon tint rendering?

No. We rewrite App Store Connect listing metadata and screenshot caption text only. Icon tint engineering and in-app theme UI strings are separate work.

What Tinted Icons-specific listing copy does AppLocale deliver?

Paste-ready zh-Hans name, subtitle, keywords, description, and caption lines on screenshots that show Customize Home Screen tint pickers, light/dark/tinted modes, color swatches, or English overlays like Tinted Icons, Icon tint, and Dark icons.

How is this different from Home Screen widgets, Lock Screen widgets, or interactive widgets?

Tinted Icons ≠ Home Screen widgets ≠ Lock Screen widgets ≠ Interactive widgets. This page covers system-wide Home Screen icon tinting — light/dark/tinted modes, 着色图标. WidgetKit gallery marketing is the Home Screen widgets guide. Lock Screen accessory slots are the Lock Screen widgets guide. Tap/toggle interactive widgets are the Interactive widgets guide.

How is this different from Smart Stack, StandBy, Control Center, or Focus modes?

Smart Stack is Apple Watch face widget rotation. StandBy is landscape charging nightstand mode. Control Center is swipe-down toggles. Focus modes are notification profiles and Focus Filters. Tinted Icons are system-wide Home Screen icon recoloring — not watch stacks, not nightstand carousels, not Control Center controls, and not Do Not Disturb profiles.

How is this different from alternate app icons?

Alternate app icons are per-app seasonal or themed icon pickers inside one binary. Tinted Icons are Apple's system-wide appearance modes that tint every app icon on the Home Screen grid. See the Alternate app icons guide only when Choose Icon picker marketing is your lead story.

Does localizing Tinted Icons screenshots fix in-app tint behavior?

No. Listing captions do not change how iOS renders tinted icons at runtime. System Tinted Icons behavior is controlled by iOS — outside AppLocale scope.
